target.title: Workspaces: add secure preview widget
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Workspaces has no first-class preview panel for inspecting a development server or deployed page without leaving the operator workspace. The legacy implementation targeted the removed dashboard stack and could not be safely rebased.

## Why This Change Was Made

This rebuild adds `builtin:preview` directly to the current Workspaces registry and schema. It shares the hosted-widget URL gate with `iframe-embed`, fails closed when a URL is disallowed, preserves the existing iframe sandbox ceiling (`allow-scripts`, never `allow-same-origin`), and implements reload without reaching into `contentWindow`. Desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport controls expose accessible labels and selected state.

## User Impact

Workspace authors can add a preview widget, bind it to an allowed URL, reload it, and inspect desktop/tablet/mobile layouts. Disallowed or unavailable URLs remain blocked, and existing custom-widget/iframe security policy is not weakened.

Generated locale synchronization remains intentionally separate: the English source adds nine keys, while the repository's 20 generated locales require an authenticated translation provider. No generated locale was hand-edited or filled with fallback-only output.

## Evidence

- Rebuilt on current `main` and current `extensions/workspaces` / Control UI contracts; no legacy dashboard core is carried forward.
- Focused Vitest: 50/50 schema and widget assertions passed after the final rebase.
- Scoped `oxfmt` / `oxlint`: clean.
- Dead-export baseline check: clean before final rebase; the preview URL evaluator now has a production caller.
- UI production build: green.
- Type checks: UI production, extensions production, and extensions tests green; final UI-test type check was deferred behind a shared heavyweight-check lock.
- Local autoreview rerun: no actionable findings.
- `git diff --check`: clean.
- Known external gate: `pnpm ui:i18n:check` reports the nine new English keys as dirty across 20 generated locales until authenticated translation sync is available.
